attempts.prompt:
Use case: compositing.
Asset type: one original-size-compatible Hearts of Iron IV character portrait replacement.
Image 1 is the original HOI4 portrait and composition target. Image 2 is the user's exact 奶龙 identity reference: a smooth golden-yellow round creature with green rings around black eyes, a small horizontal mouth and creamy belly.
Replace the human head, body and exposed human skin with this recognizable yellow mascot. RETAIN the original person's visible hairstyle, hairline, hair color, eyebrows, moustache, beard and sideburns as distinguishing features attached to the mascot, adapting them to its round head. Match the original's parting, thickness, curls and facial-hair shape. Preserve a bald scalp or clean-shaven face only where the original actually has one. Do not invent hair hidden under a hat.
Preserve the original garment design, uniform type, fabric, colors, headgear, glasses, decorations, accessories, expression, gaze, pose, action, framing, lighting, background and painterly color treatment. RETAILOR the collar/neck opening and shoulder fit to the mascot rather than copying a narrow human neck opening. Keep all existing garment design details and insignia; do not invent new hats, uniforms, medals or symbols. Use only visually present features; do not infer appearance from filenames or historical biographies.
Keep the yellow creature's anatomy, large green-ringed black eyes and small horizontal mouth; do not restore human skin, human nose or human ears. Express the original mood through its creature eyes and mouth plus retained eyebrows.
Facial-hair placement: wherever the original has a moustache and chin beard, their top-to-bottom order is eyes, UPPER-LIP moustache, small horizontal mouth, chin beard. Never place the visible mouth above the moustache or turn the moustache into a second beard. Clean-shaven originals stay clean-shaven.
Collar and anatomy: use a compact rounded mascot head seated close to broad shoulders, with a very short, wide neck transition. No tall cylindrical/giraffe neck, no long tapered yellow stalk above the clothing. The entire neck base must fit INSIDE a correctly sized collar opening. Widen and reshape the collar opening naturally around that base while keeping the original collar style, tabs, piping and badges. Collar front sits visibly in front of the lower neck; collar back sits behind it, with coherent perspective, contact shadow and fabric tension. No neck clipping through collar, pinched narrow ring, floating collar, broken seam or abrupt geometric junction. The creamy belly stays under opaque clothing; never add a cream/white bib on the neck. Respect this fit even for tiny advisor or pilot portraits.
The head silhouette is nearly round or a SHORT egg shape. Its chin rests immediately above the garment collar, without copying the original human neck length. Preserve the shoulder position and crop by broadening the fitted garment; do not fill that space with a tall yellow column.
The garment meets the underside of a visibly rounded chin. There is no separate exposed vertical neck column between the head and collar, including bald and three-quarter-view portraits.
Keep the source's fastening state: a buttoned closed standing collar remains closed and buttoned, with both front ends meeting naturally at the center seam. Do not turn a closed military collar into a deep V-neck or unbuttoned shirt. Preserve open lapels/shirt collars only where the original is actually open.
Preserve the source aspect ratio, crop and number of figures. Preserve real alpha transparency, photographic frames, note cards and existing decorative markings where present. Do not add such framing where absent. Polished painterly HOI4 finish, legible at the original in-game size. One source image to one asset. No comparison board, new text, label, watermark or extra figure.

Visible source-specific features: Brown/khaki peaked field cap with red band and original gold braid/badge, fine ROUND/OVAL wire-rim spectacles, small gray side hair. Clean-shaven without moustache or beard. Original field KHAKI SHIRT with loose OPEN pointed collar and visible bare neckline, no tie. Preserve original unbuttoned state; fit the collar around yellow skin without adding a cream bib. Retain the exact original visible hair, headgear and accessories. Any moustache stays ABOVE the small horizontal mouth. Use a nearly round head seated directly above the properly fitted collar with broad shoulders, no separate tall yellow neck, no cream neck bib, no human nose or ears. Preserve original garment opening/closure, pose, lighting and crop.

Correct the head/neck/collar/shoulder fit. REMOVE the separate exposed yellow neck and the elongated lower face. Raise and broaden the existing garment collar and shoulder fit until cloth touches the UNDERSIDE of that rounded chin. Do not merely add another yellow roll below the chin. No vertical yellow column under the chin, double-chin neck roll, thin collar choking a wide neck, tall tapered stalk, floating collar, broken seams or cream/white skin bib. The lower head silhouette curves INWARD toward its base rather than continuing down as parallel straight yellow sides. Keep garment fabric in front of and behind the head base with contact shadows and coherent seams.
Preserve the existing golden-yellow mascot identity, green-ringed black eyes and small horizontal mouth. Preserve the original visible hairstyle, hairline, side hair, brows and facial hair, eyewear and headgear; bald/clean-shaven only when actually shown in Image 2. Moustaches belong ABOVE the small mouth, never below it as a beard. Preserve original uniform/shirt design, cloth colors, insignia, tabs, decorations, glasses, tie/strap where present, opening/closure, gaze, pose, source aspect ratio, crop, background and painterly HOI4 finish. No human skin, nose or ears. One final portrait, no comparison board, new text, labels, symbols or extra figures.

Source-specific invariants: Restore the original fine wire spectacles visible in Image 2. Retain original khaki peaked cap with red band and original badge, sparse gray side hair, no moustache or beard. Original khaki field SHIRT with OPEN folded collar, exposed small upper neckline, diagonal strap and NO TIE. Raise and widen that original open neckline to meet the rounded chin; only a very short curved yellow skin arc may appear inside the opening, never a long yellow V/funnel down the chest.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the accepted generated portrait to correct, Image 2 is the original game portrait governing clothes, pose and appearance, Image 3 is the exact user yellow mascot reference.
Change ONLY the lower-head/neck/clothing fit. The current picture has a LONG YELLOW V-SHAPED FUNNEL below the rounded chin, extending down into the open shirt. Natural collar front/back occlusion, folds, seams and contact shadows, no pinched ring or floating cloth, no cream belly at the neck.
Preserve the original khaki cap with red band and badge, sparse gray side hair and gray brows, clean-shaven face, green-ring black mascot eyes, small horizontal mouth, khaki shirt fabric, original shoulder marks and diagonal strap, painterly finish, pose, crop and background. NO TIE, no moustache or beard. Direct review of the enlarged original confirms NO GLASSES: its eyelid wrinkles are not spectacles. Do not add eyeglasses.
